stories.title: La Cabra, la cafetería de especialidad más copiada del mundo, aterriza en España

en.title: La Cabra, the world's most copied specialty café, lands in Spain
en.summary: Danish specialty coffee company La Cabra has opened its first café location in Madrid, situated within a historic jewelry shop.

stories.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,6 sacude el centro y el sur de Panamá

en.title: An earthquake of magnitude 7.6 shakes central and southern Panama
en.summary: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake struck Panama on Friday, initially measured at 8.0 before being revised downward, with the epicenter in the south-central region and followed by several significant aftershocks.

stories.title: Trump anuncia un acuerdo con Putin para que EE.UU. reciba diésel de Rusia

en.title: Trump announces agreement with Putin for U.S. to receive diesel from Russia
en.summary: The U.S. president announced an agreement with Russia's leader to supply millions of tons of diesel to American and global markets to reduce prices, addressing concerns among Republican allies about high fuel costs.

stories.title: La Cabra, la cafetería danesa de reconocimiento internacional, aterriza en Madrid con una experiencia multisensorial en torno al café y al pan

en.title: La Cabra, the internationally recognized Danish café, lands in Madrid with a multisensory coffee and bread experience
en.summary: La Cabra has opened a minimalist design café in Madrid's Chueca neighborhood featuring light roast coffee from Colombia, Ethiopia, and Kenya, alongside fresh daily baked goods and pastries.

stories.title: Trump acuerda con Putin el suministro de diésel ruso a los mercados mundiales

en.title: Trump agrees with Putin on Russian diesel supply to world markets
en.summary: The U.S. president announced an agreement with Moscow for the immediate release of Russian diesel to global markets in phased shipments totaling millions of tons.

stories.title: Trump llega a un acuerdo con Putin para que Rusia libere miles de barriles de diésel en los mercados mundiales

en.title: Trump reaches agreement with Putin for Russia to release thousands of barrels of diesel into world markets
en.summary: Trump and Putin have agreed on a deal involving Russian diesel releases into global markets, announced weeks before elections as fuel prices impact Republican electoral prospects.

stories.title: Mohamed VI avisa de que no aceptará “presión, amenaza ni chantaje” desde España en vísperas del viaje de Felipe VI

en.title: Mohamed VI warns he will not accept "pressure, threat or blackmail" from Spain ahead of Felipe VI's visit
en.summary: Morocco's king cautioned that bilateral cooperation faces serious challenges and objected to Spanish policies regarding repatriation of Moroccan minors and adults, ahead of a Spanish royal visit.

stories.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,7 sacude el sur de Panamá

en.title: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake shakes southern Panama
en.summary: A powerful earthquake struck southern Panama with no reported casualties, though tsunami alerts were lifted early morning from some coastal zones in other countries.

stories.title: Mohamed VI avisa a España que no aceptará “presión, amenaza ni chantaje”

en.title: Mohamed VI warns Spain it will not accept "pressure, threat or blackmail"
en.summary: Morocco's king announced he will propose a new migration cooperation strategy to Spain as part of broader diplomatic discussions.

stories.title: El Nobel de la Paz a Navi Pillay desata la indignación de Israel en plena campaña electoral

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize to Navi Pillay sparks Israeli outrage during electoral campaign
en.summary: Israel's government rejected the Nobel Peace Prize awarded to South African jurist Navi Pillay, who championed a UN report accusing Israel of genocide in Gaza.

stories.title: South African lawyer Navi Pillay awarded 2026 Nobel Peace Prize

en.title: South African lawyer Navi Pillay awarded 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: The Norwegian Nobel committee recognized South African lawyer Navi Pillay's efforts to promote peace and international law while bringing hope to victims of violence and conflict.

stories.title: La jurista sudafricana Navanethem Pillay gana el Nobel de Paz del 2026

en.title: South African jurist Navanethem Pillay wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay, an experienced legal professional from South Africa, has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her work advancing international law and legal rights.

stories.title: La EBA vigila de cerca la cartera de deuda de la banca

en.title: EBA closely monitors banking debt portfolio
en.summary: European banking regulators are increasing surveillance of bond-related risks held by financial institutions, though current exposure levels remain manageable.

stories.title: JTI acelera en tabaco calentado: "En 10 años su presencia será enorme"

en.title: JTI accelerates in heated tobacco: "In 10 years its presence will be enormous"
en.summary: Japanese tobacco company JTI, which owns Camel and Winston brands, is expanding its heated tobacco business and plans to invest 4.5 billion euros through 2028 in these alternative products.

en.summary: Paris stock exchange has declined 12 percent from its August peak levels.

en.title: Electric cars accelerate in Spain: these are the best sellers
en.summary: Electric passenger vehicles are experiencing the fastest growth in Spain, surpassing 100,000 units registered during the first nine months of the year.

stories.title: Josh Payne, el minero australiano que conquistó a los gigantes de la IA

en.title: Josh Payne, the Australian miner who conquered AI giants
en.summary: An Australian miner backed by Sheryl Sandberg and Jensen Huang aims to develop Nscale into a hyperscaler valued at one trillion dollars.
